fullDescription: A cinematic, true-grayscale editorial landing page for a creative or film/motion studio. A full-viewport hero pairs a full-bleed black-and-white portrait with a 1px hairline frame box on the right holding a tracked all-caps overline, a two-weight Franklin Gothic headline (bold name + light descriptor), a small "SHOWREEL" label, and a down-arrow scroll cue. Below: an introduction (portrait + serif-free editorial copy + italic byline), a "Body of Work" project grid with tracked-caps captions, a full-bleed cinematic photo band, a four-up stat row split by hairline rules, and a "Selected Recognition" list beside a hairline-framed CTA, closing on a black footer. One typeface (Libre Franklin / Franklin Gothic), black + white + grey only, no accent colour. Reusable for any studio, agency, photographer, or director portfolio.
prompt:
## Resumo
A cinematic, true-grayscale editorial landing page for a creative studio (film / motion / photography / design). It opens on a full-viewport hero: a full-bleed desaturated black-and-white portrait with a thin top nav (wordmark left, Projects / Studio / Contact right), and on the right third a 1px hairline frame box holding a tracked all-caps overline ('WEAVERS OF LIGHT AND SHADOW'), a two-weight headline (bold studio name + lighter descriptor line, e.g. 'MERIDIAN' / 'Film + Motion Studio'), a small tracked 'SHOWREEL 2024' label bottom-left, and a down-arrow scroll cue bottom-right. Below, an Introduction section pairs a grayscale portrait with a tracked 'INTRODUCTION' eyebrow, a large sans headline, an editorial paragraph, and an italic 'Founder & Creative Director' byline. A soft-grey 'Body of Work' section shows a three-up project grid (each = a grayscale still + tracked-caps title + medium/year caption) with a '2021-PRESENT' marker. A full-bleed cinematic photo band follows. Then a four-up stat row (big numbers + tracked-caps labels) divided by 1px hairline rules. A 'Selected Recognition' section lists press entries with right-aligned meta beside a hairline-framed 'Start the conversation' CTA. It closes on a black footer (copyright + Instagram / Vimeo / LinkedIn).

## Estilo Visual
Design a single-page, full-viewport landing page in STRICT true grayscale (black #111, white #fff, greys, soft-grey #f4f4f4) with NO accent colour anywhere; the only colour is fully-desaturated (grayscale) cinematic photography. Use ONE typeface only, Libre Franklin (Franklin Gothic feel), and build all hierarchy from weight + size: 700 for names/section titles, 400 (and italic) for descriptors/body. Labels and overlines are 11-12px ALL CAPS, letter-spacing ~0.18em. Keep an aggressive scale ratio (hero ~75px vs labels ~12px). Use thin 1px hairlines for the hero frame box and the stat dividers. Alternate pure-white, full-bleed-photo, and soft-grey sections. Subtle fade/rise on scroll only. Do NOT introduce a second typeface or any accent colour.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Nav + Hero
Full viewport (100vh). Full-bleed desaturated black-and-white portrait (dramatic side light, subject looking toward camera). A thin transparent top nav: bold wordmark left, tracked-caps links (Projects / Studio / Contact) right, all white. On the right ~third, a 1px white hairline border box containing: a small tracked all-caps overline ('WEAVERS OF LIGHT AND SHADOW'), a two-weight headline at ~75px (studio name in 700 + a descriptor line in 400, e.g. 'MERIDIAN' / 'Film + Motion Studio'), a small tracked 'SHOWREEL 2024' label bottom-left of the box, and a white down-arrow scroll cue bottom-right.

### Introduction
White section. Left: a portrait-orientation grayscale photo. Right: a tracked-caps 'INTRODUCTION' eyebrow, a large (~30px) 700 sans headline (2-3 lines), a ~14px grey editorial paragraph, and an italic 400 byline ('Founder & Creative Director - [Name]').

### Body of Work
Soft-grey (#f4f4f4) section. A large 700 'Body of Work' title with a right-aligned tracked-caps '2021-PRESENT' marker, then a three-column project grid: each card = a landscape grayscale still, a tracked-caps title ('ETHEREAL PLANES'), and a medium/year caption ('NARRATIVE SHORT - 2023').

### Cinematic band
A full-bleed, edge-to-edge desaturated cinematic photo band (e.g. a film projector in a dark, smoky room) with no text - a visual breath between sections.

### Accolades
White section. A single row of four stat blocks divided by 1px vertical hairline rules (with hairlines above and below the row): each = a big 700 number ('12', '85+', '09', '14') and a tiny tracked-caps label ('GLOBAL AWARDS', 'FILM PRODUCTIONS', 'YEARS IN MOTION', 'FESTIVAL LAURELS').

### Recognition + CTA
Soft-grey section, two columns. Left: a tracked-caps 'SELECTED RECOGNITION' eyebrow over a list of press rows (bold publication left, grey meta right, e.g. 'VOGUE CINEMATIC ... Artist Profile / 2024') separated by hairlines. Right: a 1px hairline-framed CTA box echoing the hero box - a tracked-caps 'WORK WITH US' label, a large 700 'Start the conversation' headline, and a tracked-caps 'CONNECT ->' link.

### Footer
A black footer band: small grey copyright left ('© 2024 [Studio]. All rights reserved.'), tracked-caps social links right (Instagram / Vimeo / LinkedIn).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Hairline hero frame box — A 1px-bordered container grouping all hero text against the photo.
On the right third of the hero, a container with a 1px hairline border (white at ~35% opacity over the photo). Inside, stack a tracked all-caps overline, a two-weight headline (bold name + lighter descriptor line), a small-caps label pinned bottom-left, and a down-arrow scroll cue bottom-right.

### Two-weight single-typeface headline — Hierarchy from weight, not a second font.
Set the studio name in Libre Franklin 700 and the descriptor line in Libre Franklin 400 (or 400 italic), same ~75px size, stacked on two lines. Never introduce a second typeface.

### Tracked all-caps labels — Editorial furniture: eyebrows, captions, nav, section labels.
Render eyebrows, section labels, nav links and captions at 11-12px, uppercase, letter-spacing ~0.18em, in muted grey or white.

### Hairline-divided stat row — A four-up metrics row separated by 1px rules.
A single row of four stat blocks divided by 1px vertical hairline rules, with hairlines above and below the row; each block = a big 700 number over a tiny tracked-caps label.

### Full-bleed grayscale photo band — An edge-to-edge desaturated image used as a section break.
A 100%-width, fixed-height cinematic photo fully desaturated (filter: grayscale(1)) with no text - a visual breath between content sections.

### Hairline-framed CTA echo — A closing CTA that repeats the hero's framed box.
A 1px hairline-bordered box mirroring the hero frame: a tracked-caps label, a large 700 headline ('Start the conversation'), and a tracked-caps 'CONNECT ->' link.

style.description: Cinematic, quiet-luxury editorial minimalism. STRICT true grayscale: black, white, and grey only, with fully desaturated photography as the single source of 'colour', never a hue. ONE typeface doing all the work via weight + size (Libre Franklin / Franklin Gothic): heavy 700 for names and section titles, book 400 (and italic) for descriptors and body. An aggressive scale ratio (hero headline ~72-76px vs 11-12px tracked all-caps labels, no timid mid-sizes). Thin 1px hairlines (frame boxes, stat dividers) are the primary structural device. Generous white space; alternating pure-white and full-bleed-photo and soft-grey sections for rhythm. Motion is restrained: fade/rise on scroll only, no bounce, no colour transitions.
